question: Soulflower brand parent company manufacturer
markdown:
Soulflower is an independent Indian clean beauty and personal care brand
founded in Mumbai in 2001 by Natasha Tuli and Amit Sarda. It operates under its own enterprise,
Soulflower India Pvt. Ltd.
, and is backed by a minority investment from
⁠Wipro Consumer Care-Ventures
, but it is not wholly owned or manufactured by a larger parent
FMCG corporation
